rationale: Restore semantic checkpoint review before PR publication, prevent static checks from fabricating approval, make publication a mandatory core skill, add a runtime-bound process graph, and define safe self-hosted authority rotation.
migration: Consumers must adopt the mandatory publish-change core skill, use process-graph validation, supply a host-produced semantic review report before completion, transport only validated completion evidence to remote publication adapters, create PRs only after source/evidence validation, and rotate self-hosted trust roots through old-authority introduction before immutable cutover.
